gamerule.nonTruePvPDamageReduction: Damage Reduction Outside Of True PvP
gamerule.nonTruePvPDamageReduction.descr: How much damage is reduced between two players not in a duel (as a percentage). 1 removes all damage, 0 disables damage reduction.
gamerule.standoffTimerDuration.descripti: How long the standoff is before the duel should last (in seconds).
gamerule.timeBeforeDisengage.description: How long until the duel ends because players didn't take damage
gamerule.timeBeforeDisengagePlayer: Time Without Player Damage To Disengage
gamerule.timeBeforeDisengagePlayer.descr: How long until the duel ends because players didn't take damage from the opponent
gamerule.doConsumeGauntlets.description: If true, gauntlets will be consumed when used to start a duel. If false, gauntlets will not be consumed.
gamerule.doGauntletsHeal.description: If true, gauntlets will heal players fully when used to start a duel. If false, gauntlets will not heal players.

pvpgauntlets.duel.abandoned.error: %s abandoned a duel, but the other player isn't online. This is likely a bug, please report it to the mod author.
